package.description: A command line client for the QIAGEN CLC Genomics Server.

en-US.description: A command line client for the QIAGEN CLC Genomics Server.
en-US.longDescription: QIAGEN CLC Server Command Line Tools provides a command line client for the QIAGEN CLC Genomics Server. This client software can be used to launch bioinformatics analyses including workflows, import and export data, and carry out utility operations such as moving, renaming, and deleting data. Commands can be run directly or included in scripts.
en-US.name: CLC Server Command Line Tools

zh-CN.description: QIAGEN CLC 基因组服务器的命令行客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: QIAGEN CLC Server Command Line Tools 提供了一个用于 QIAGEN CLC 基因组服务器的命令行客户端。该客户端软件可用于启动包括工作流程在内的生物信息学分析，导入和导出数据，以及执行诸如移动、重命名和删除数据等实用操作。命令可以直接运行，也可以包含在脚本中。
